notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New features
- The game now supports controllers and automatically detects when you are using one.
- In the game settings, you can disable automatic controller detection if the game detects a device that you neither want to use nor disconnect.
- Most buttons can be freely reassigned. The exceptions are the D-pad and the axes for movement and looking around.
- If the game displays incorrect button labels for your controller, try changing the "button layout" option in the settings.

Changes
- The camera work while riding on animals no longer requires constant correction of the viewing direction during turns.
- Kasimir now dries off much faster when wet, especially near a lit stove.
- Manure pits and composters are now twice as capacious (therefore, the visual level of filling has seemingly dropped by half).
- Most races can be run on animals of either gender, so nothing stands in the way of defeating stallion Filip on the back of a mare.
- Our beloved Tekla is finally starting to feel her age. Our fistfight champion is now slightly less combative, but still not to be underestimated.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
- the bug causing the game to crash (usually during the "Drunk Bike Day") was finally found and mercilessly crushed
- you can not "rob" the shop freely anymore (invisible crate is gone, sorry)
- additional shadowing is no longer forced on low and very low settings (more FPS)
- various tweaks and fixes (like missing texts related to landmines)

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
- The hammer is back where it belongs (in the woodshed)
- Some nasty neighbour took our old trusty wrench...
- You can put bait in the traps now (and take it out too)
- "Host Vision" is "Landlord's Vision" from now on
- The Sawmill is no longer home for a paranormal entity launching poor animals in the air
